## Procedure

## Parts

- Hose: Molded OEM or custom hydraulic shop hose [t2289]
- [Partial] Reservoir Assembly: OEM molded shape preferred [t2289]

## Tips & gotchas

- The return line is the suction hose that can suck up air if leaking. [t2289]
- OEM molded hoses are cheap but prone to cracking near exhaust manifolds. [t2289]
